description: Live on-chain market data for any token on 80+ chains and DEXes (Uniswap, Raydium, PancakeSwap, Aerodrome...): price, liquidity, 24h volume, buys vs sells, market cap and pair age. Search by name/ticker or look up a contract address. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

address.description: Token contract address (EVM 0x... or Solana mint).

chain.description: Chain to look on with an address, e.g. "base", "ethereum", "solana", "bsc". Default: all.

limit.description: Number of pairs. Default 5, most liquid first.

query.description: Token name or ticker, e.g. "PEPE". Use this or address.

name: dex_token
title: DEX token and pair data
